europe_now.title: Slovak drone factory targeted in Russian-linked arson attack
europe_now.summary: A Slovak drone manufacturing facility narrowly avoided major damage after a napalm-fueled arson attack that authorities are linking to Russian operatives. Three foreign suspects have been arrested in connection with the incident, which underscores growing concerns over hybrid warfare targeting critical infrastructure in Central Europe.

sources.headline: Slovak drone factory narrowly escapes Russian-linked napalm arson attack as police arrest three foreign suspects

europe_now.title: Iceland prepares for EU membership referendum vote
europe_now.summary: Iceland is set to hold a closely contested referendum on whether to reopen negotiations for European Union membership, a decision that could reshape the country's geopolitical alignment. The vote reflects ongoing domestic divisions over the benefits and risks of deeper integration with European institutions.

sources.headline: Iceland to vote on reopening EU membership talks in close referendum

top_stories.title: France and Germany clash over industrial policy direction
top_stories.summary: France and Germany are locked in a dispute over the future of European industrial strategy, with disagreements centering on state aid rules and green technology investments. The rift highlights broader tensions within the EU about how to balance economic sovereignty with collective competitiveness.

sources.headline: France and Germany collide over Europe’s industrial future

top_stories.title: Polish prosecutors investigate crypto firm ties to opposition figures
top_stories.summary: Polish prosecutors have launched an investigation into a cryptocurrency company suspected of channeling funds to conservative opposition politicians and organizations. The probe raises questions about financial transparency and foreign influence in Poland's domestic political landscape.

sources.headline: Polish prosecutors investigate crypto firm’s links to conservative opposition politicians and organisations

top_stories.title: Migration pressures intensify around Spain's Ceuta enclave
top_stories.summary: Tensions continue to rise at Spain's Ceuta enclave as migration flows remain high, prompting increased security measures and humanitarian responses. The situation reflects broader challenges facing European border management amid shifting migration patterns.
